warning: Directory suffix and declared project version differ; content is authoritative.
method: Read-only source triage against source_v065, preserving labelled v064 screenshot/headless evidence only where relevant code still supports the claim. No new runtime playthrough is claimed.

removed_fixed.evidence: decline_contract removes unaccepted offers, advances cooldown to at most six seconds, and Jobs provides a Decline button.
_reachable_resources collects connected enabled producer/converter outputs; stock options filter through this set, with a Cycles fallback.

design.title: Add a small discover-and-compromise loop before automation
design.notes: Placement still instantly creates an owned producer; discovery/acquisition states remain a proposal.

design.title: Make compromised hosts look acquired rather than newly constructed
design.notes: Player nodes still use tiered architecture, roof and window profiles. Canonical inspector operational-state labels do not change ownership rendering.

design.title: Teach a sustainable Cycles backbone before expanding Intel sales
design.notes: The new post-build recovery-reserve forecast does not change _next_step: opening guidance still asks for Intel before testing sustainable Cycles income.

design.title: Validate an accessible starter route for each generated map
design.notes: Generation and first-residential hub placement remain unvalidated for a guaranteed affordable opening route.

design.title: Separate victory progress from the wallet spent on upgrades
design.notes: Victory still uses current credits >= 1000; facility and tunnel Cash purchases reduce that same wallet.

design.title: Give the central Spire a simple end-of-run purpose
design.notes: Spire remains an ICE-3 district with no unique completion operation; Cash is still the only win check.

design.title: Allow players to replay and share a map seed
design.notes: Promote replacement: New Game still assigns randi(), with no seed field or restart-same-seed action. Menu Accessibility additions do not provide map replay.

design.title: Permit a small set of producer upgrades that preserve the route
design.notes: Promote replacement: begin_reroute changes an existing edge, not producer type. Replacing a producer still requires removal, which detaches its children.

design.title: Make Onion Routing's long-reach promise measurable
design.notes: Every TUNNEL_MAXLEN remains 255; long-route niche recommendation is still valid.

design.title: Stop optional Labs consuming inputs after the last useful unlock
design.notes: Lab consumption still runs after the finite TECH set is fully unlocked; no auto-standby or repeatable Research use was added.

design.title: Make going quiet a meaningful answer to escalating pursuit
design.notes: Notoriety still never decays and independently charges sweeps. New reroute affordance adds active evasion but does not make quieting prevent notoriety-driven pursuit.

design.title: Account for route latency and supply rate in contract difficulty
design.notes: Stock eligibility is now filtered, but quantity/deadline/reward tiers remain fixed and do not use actual rates, slow_factor or route latency. Narrow the evidence to those remaining factors.
design.evidence_override: Stock offers are now filtered to currently reachable resource types. Stock/node/Cash deadlines remain 90/120/100 seconds with random quantities; no current income, slow_factor or route-travel allowance affects their difficulty.
design.reproduction_override: Compare the same eligible 50-Intel/90-second offer on a short sustainable route versus a long starved route; eligibility may match while attainable delivery differs.

design.title: Align coverage tuning with the actual radius-four grid ceiling
design.notes: Radius, four-cell blocks, integer disk and coverage/5 are unchanged; the seven-building, 1.4 upper-bound proof still applies.

map.title: Armed tunnel and Proxy tools still miss visible tower roofs
map.notes: _try_tunnel and _try_convert_relay still call _node_at(cell); the new rerouting path also uses the same footprint target policy. Prior headless roof-hit proof remains applicable.

map.title: Undo can leave a stationary route preview showing an obsolete route
map.notes: Cache key still uses only cell, pending source and tool. Undo target removal/restore still does not invalidate this cache; new reroute Undo also clears only _pl_cache.

map.title: Empty-cell route endpoints can display OK but cannot be committed
map.notes: Empty-cell fallback can still return blocked=false and OK while commit requires an existing node.

map.title: Proxy tunnel previews overstate upkeep by 2.5 times
map.notes: Tunnel preview still uses length*UPKEEP; actual Proxy source upkeep still applies 0.4. Post-build reserve forecast is in the structure branch only.

map.title: Keep the pointed-at host stable when wheel-zooming
map.notes: _zoom still changes scale without preserving the world point beneath the pointer.

map.title: Bound camera travel and provide a quick return to C2
map.notes: Pan/drag/edge updates still have no world clamp and no dedicated return-to-C2 control is present.

map.title: The top HUD can trigger unintended upward edge-panning
map.notes: Edge-pan still triggers y<=22 when x>=300, including the top HUD.

map.title: Preserve map proportions in the minimap
map.notes: Minimap draw/click transforms and 284x148 UI size are unchanged; aspect-distortion finding remains.

map.title: Minimap view rectangle includes world hidden behind the UI
map.notes: Minimap outline still uses the full viewport, including the covered left panel and top HUD.

map.title: Show currently accessible territory on the minimap
map.notes: Minimap texture still colours all districts without the current access/vision overlay.

map.title: Use the minimap to locate network health and the current selection
map.notes: Canonical _op_state now exists for the inspector, but minimap markers still ignore it, selection and sweep position.

map.title: ICE tracers cut across buildings instead of following their real tunnels
map.notes: Threat warning lines and tracer still interpolate directly between node centres rather than _edge_pts.

map.title: Short-link labels are covered by the structures they describe
map.notes: Link labels still paint before structures at the route midpoint with no collision handling/backing. Prior short-link screenshot evidence remains mechanically relevant.

map.title: Fog blocks and legal placement disagree at vision boundaries
map.notes: Fog still marks whole 4x4 blocks from one centre-cell test while placement checks every footprint cell against exact radius.

not_promoted_prior_candidate.evidence: UI now queues action messages by severity and retains a 12-message history, so original no-event-history wording is stale. History still has no visible recall flow, but that would need a narrower separate proposal.
